title: Sports News & Article Management Platform
summary: A dynamic sports news platform with an admin panel for article creation, categories and tags and a responsive frontend for content discovery.
result: Scalable content publishing and discovery workflow
challenge: The platform needed flexible content management and an efficient way for users to browse sports articles by categories and tags.
solution: Built a dynamic React.js frontend for sports content.
Developed a Node.js backend with MongoDB.
Created admin workflows for article creation and organization.
Implemented categories and tags for content discovery.
Designed the interface to be responsive and scalable.
outcomes: Delivered flexible article publishing and organization.
Improved content discovery through categories and tags.
